entry._note: Entry t+120..240s any grade>=B (price 0.50-0.75, pay the ask); later only score>=7 with >=6m left; nothing after t+540s. Min edge 0.03, but 0.05 for ask/limit 0.60-0.70 inclusive (edge_bands).

orderflow._note: YoungBuffett/Bucko bookmeter: block LONG if Binance BTCUSDT 1m taker delta <= -$1M, SHORT if >= +$1M. $1M ~ 95th pct of |1m delta| over the last ~7 days (10k minutes); blocks ~3% of minutes per side. Source data-api.binance.vision 1s klines (api.binance.com is geo-blocked 451). Fallback Coinbase in-memory trades at 0.5x threshold ($500k). Fails open if no data <30s old.

exit._note: No stop-loss (losers held to settlement). Exits, first to trigger wins: CEIL bid>=0.92, mid_window TP_MID (+15% net) / BE (<=180s left), TP +0.20 sells the whole position.

mid_window._note: Applies to every entry (0-900s left). Sell ALL once bid minus exit taker fee >= 1.15 x all-in entry cost per contract (entry price + entry fee). If not hit and <=180s left, sell ALL as soon as bid minus exit fee >= all-in entry cost (true breakeven). The +0.20 TP still applies too (whichever triggers first). Neither -> hold to settlement (no SL). CEIL 0.92 checked first; no exits in the last exit_buffer_sec (60s). Applies to paper + live.

live._note: Hard caps in btcbot/live.py: grade sizing B $10 / A $15 / A+ $20 (hard max $20), stake steps down 20->15->10 if the full stake could breach the $100 daily loss cap, 50 trades/day, 1 open position, score>=5. Config can only lower them.

_note: paper=true keeps the paper ledger running in parallel; live block controls real orders.

chop._note: MIXED/WAIT = skip: ribbon + 15m ctx (trend) and 1m mom + 10s trigger (momentum) must agree with side; skip if 10m efficiency ratio < er_min or 10m range < range_atr_min x ATR14
